articles.title: Struggling to afford retirement, older Australians call for pension increase
articles.description: Many older Australians are struggling with rising living costs, housing expenses and healthcare bills, leaving them unable to enjoy the retirement they planned for.
articles.source: ABC News & Headlines – Australian Broadcasting Corporation

articles.title: Javits Frimpong fatally shot walking to school in Bronx; 3 teens sought in shooting
articles.description: A 15-year-old was shot in the stomach near Crotona Park in the Bronx on Thursday while walking to school. Three suspects are being sought.

articles.title: Migrant staff worked up to 98-hour weeks at motel but paid for 40
articles.description: An Immigration NZ investigation found the four staff were essentially running the motel from morning until night while being paid a fraction of hours worked.
